titlebar.updateReady: Update ready · installs when you close
titlebar.updateReadyBusy: Update ready · wait for games and installs to finish

home.emptyBody: An instance is one Minecraft setup: a version, a loader and its own worlds.
home.deleteBody: This removes the instance and everything in it, including worlds and screenshots. It can't be undone.

image.title: Change image
image.body: The icon marks this instance; the background fills the screen behind its name.
image.uploadHintBackground: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Best at 1920 × 1080 or larger.
image.uploadHintIcon: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Square works best.
image.positionHint: Drag to choose which part of the picture stays in view.

manual.title: Download these manually
manual.body: Their authors only allow downloads from CurseForge. Open each page and download the file. We'll find it in your Downloads folder.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Nothing is happening right now. Press Play and the game's output shows up here.
activity.logEmpty: The game hasn't printed anything yet.
activity.oomBody: Give it more memory and press Play again.

newInstance.title: New instance
newInstance.name: Name
newInstance.noLoaderForVersion: {{loader}} isn't available for this Minecraft version yet. Pick another Minecraft version, or choose None.
newInstance.linkHint: Paste a pack.toml link, or modrinth: and a project name.
newInstance.packNote: The pack's mods download the first time you press Play.

import.hint: In your other launcher, open the instance's folder (usually right-click → Open folder) and pick it here. Close the game in your other launcher first.
import.size: We'll copy {{size}}: your mods, worlds, settings and map data. The original folder isn't changed.

instanceSettings.title: Instance settings
instanceSettings.memoryHintUnknown: We couldn't read this computer's memory. Pick an amount you know it can spare.
instanceSettings.memoryHigh: That's more than half of this computer's memory. Other apps may slow down.
instanceSettings.javaArgsHint: Optional, for advanced players. Separate them with spaces and put quotes around a value with spaces. Memory is set above.
instanceSettings.applyNote: Changes apply the next time you press Play.
instanceSettings.gameFromPack: The pack picks the Minecraft version and loader.

damaged.title: “{{id}}” can't be opened
damaged.deleteBody: This removes the folder and everything in it. It can't be undone.

mods.empty: No mods yet. Add .jar files, or drop them anywhere on this screen.
mods.vanillaNote: Mods need a mod loader: Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge. You can switch this instance's loader in its settings.
mods.running: Stop the game to turn mods on or off or remove them. New mods you add apply the next time you press Play.
mods.removeBody: The file is deleted from this instance's mods folder.
mods.busy: Still adding the last files. Drop these again in a moment.
mods.optionalNote: Optional mods change the next time you play.
mods.noAdditions: Mods you add show up here. Updates never touch them.
mods.packEmpty: This pack's mods show up after its first Play.

packs.removeBody: The file is deleted from this instance.
packs.running: Stop the game to remove packs.

empty.resource_pack: No resource packs yet. Find some, or put .zip files in the folder.
empty.shader: No shaders yet. Find some, or put .zip files in the folder.

packs.shadersNeedLoader: Shaders need a mod loader: Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.removeBody: You can add it again any time. Your worlds stay where they are.
accounts.removeBodyLocked: Your worlds stay where they are. You'll be able to add offline accounts again after you sign in with Microsoft, which is coming soon.
accounts.removeBodyPending: Your worlds stay where they are.
accounts.removeNone: No accounts will be left. Play needs an account.
accounts.offlineHint: 3–16 letters, numbers or underscores. Other players see this name.
accounts.offlineLocked: Offline accounts unlock after you sign in once with a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft.

perland.title: Perland account
perland.pitch: Your servers and free servers go with you.
perland.waiting: Finish signing in with your browser
perland.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
perland.codeUsedUp: That code can't be used anymore. Ask for a new code.

settings.title: Settings
settings.minimizeHint: The launcher comes back when the game closes.
settings.license: Free software under the GNU General Public License v3.
settings.notOfficial: Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

updates.title: Launcher updates
updates.betaHint: New builds first, with a few rough edges.
updates.stableFromBeta: You'll move to stable once it's newer than your beta.
updates.off: Updates are off in developer builds.
updates.idle: Checks for updates when the launcher opens.
updates.ready: Version {{version}} is ready. It installs when you close the launcher.
updates.busy: Wait for games and installs to finish first.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.body: Saves your logs and instance settings in a .zip for whoever helps you. Your accounts and the names of your personal folders stay out.

firstRun.welcomeBody: A free launcher for Minecraft, ready in a few clicks.
firstRun.accountBody: Pick the name other players will see.
firstRun.accountLockedBody: Microsoft sign-in is coming soon. You can set up the rest now and add an account later.
firstRun.instanceBody: Start with the newest Minecraft, or pick a version.
firstRun.browseInstead: Or start from a community modpack

closeGuard.title: A game is still running
closeGuard.body: Quitting the launcher stops it. Minimize the launcher instead to keep playing.

join.title: Join server
join.inviteOnly: Invite only: ask the owner to add {{name}}
join.inviteOnlyNoAccount: Invite only: ask the owner to add you
join.note: The server's mods download the first time you press Play.
join.linkNote: When you press Play, mods the server doesn't use move to the mods-before-link folder. Your worlds and settings stay.
join.linkVersion: This server plays Minecraft {{version}} with {{loader}}. Linking moves this instance to that version, so back up your worlds first.
join.linkVersionVanilla: This server plays vanilla Minecraft {{version}}. Linking moves this instance to that version, so back up your worlds first.

server.updated: Server updated · updates when you play
server.relinkRunning: Stop the game to use a new link.
server.linkSettingsBody: Link this instance to a Perland server and it updates with the server.
server.linkRunning: Stop the game to link this instance.

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Find a Perland server and press Play.

yours.title: Your servers
yours.nudge: Sign in with Perland to keep your servers here.

servers.noMatch: No servers match. Try fewer filters.

offline_name_invalid.message: Player names must be 3–16 letters, numbers or underscores.

accounts_damaged.fix: Remove accounts.json from the data folder and add your accounts again.

offline_locked.message: Offline accounts unlock after you sign in once with a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft.

microsoft_unavailable.message: Microsoft accounts aren't supported in this version yet.

disk_io.message: Couldn't read or write a launcher file.
disk_io.fix: Check that there's free disk space and that the launcher folder isn't read-only.

disk_write_failed.fix: Check that there's free disk space and that the launcher folder isn't read-only.

download_no_url.message: This file has no download address.

download_corrupt.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, the file on the server may be broken.

download_restarted.message: The download had to start over.

host_trouble.fix: Try again in a few minutes.

connection_dropped.message: The connection dropped during a download.
connection_dropped.fix: Check your internet connection and try again.

http_client_failed.message: The launcher couldn't start its network connection.

offline.message: You seem to be offline, and this hasn't been downloaded before.
offline.fix: Connect to the internet and try again.

unsafe_game_data.message: Minecraft's file list contains something unsafe, so it was skipped.

library_unverifiable.message: Couldn't check that a downloaded file is genuine.

minecraft_version_not_found.fix: Pick a version from the list.

mojang_mismatch.message: Mojang sent a different version than the one asked for.

no_asset_index.message: {{version}} is missing its list of game assets.

natives_extract_failed.fix: Close any running Minecraft and try again.

version_in_use.message: Another copy of this Minecraft version is running.

archive_invalid.fix: Press Play again to download it again.

instance_damaged.message: The settings file of “{{id}}” is damaged.
instance_damaged.fix: Delete the instance and create it again.

instance_busy.message: Stop the game before changing this instance.

memory_out_of_range.message: Memory must be between {{min}} and {{max}} MB.

java_unavailable.message: There's no official Java ({{component}}) for this computer.
java_unavailable.fix: Choose a Java installation in the instance settings.

java_start_failed.fix: Set Java back to automatic in the instance settings.

java_path_missing.fix: Pick Java again in the instance settings, or set it back to automatic.

java_test_failed.message: That doesn't look like a working Java.
java_test_failed.fix: Pick the java program inside a Java installation's bin folder.

jvm_args_unclosed_quote.message: A quote in the Java arguments isn't closed.
jvm_args_unclosed_quote.fix: Add the closing quote, or remove the opening one.

jvm_arg_not_option.message: “{{arg}}” isn't a Java option. Each argument starts with a dash.
jvm_arg_not_option.fix: Remove it, or add the dash it's missing.

jvm_arg_not_allowed.message: “{{arg}}” can't be used here. The launcher sets the class path, the main class and how Java starts.
jvm_arg_not_allowed.fix: Remove it from the Java arguments.

jvm_args_memory.message: Memory is set with the slider, not in the Java arguments.
jvm_args_memory.fix: Remove it and move the memory slider instead.

jvm_args_too_long.message: The Java arguments are too long (over {{max}} characters).
jvm_args_too_long.fix: Remove the arguments you don't need.

no_game_arguments.message: {{version}} doesn't say how to start the game.

game_files_missing.fix: Press Play again to repair the instance.

version_invalid.fix: Pick a version from the list.

loader_version_not_found.fix: Pick a loader version from the list.

loader_installer_invalid.message: The mod loader's installer couldn't be read.
loader_installer_invalid.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, pick another loader version.

loader_too_old.message: This loader version is too old for the launcher.
loader_too_old.fix: Pick a newer Minecraft version, or another loader.

loader_processor_failed.message: Setting up the mod loader failed.
loader_processor_failed.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the details and ask for help.

loader_output_corrupt.message: A file the mod loader built came out damaged.

meta_cache_missing.message: A saved download list is missing.
meta_cache_missing.fix: Connect to the internet and try again.

meta_not_found.message: A version list wasn't found on the server.

meta_checksum.message: A downloaded version list was damaged.

meta_unexpected.message: A server sent data the launcher doesn't understand.

settings_damaged.message: Your launcher settings couldn't be read, so the defaults are in use.
settings_damaged.fix: Set your preferences again in Settings.

log_write_stopped.message: The game log stopped being saved to disk.
log_write_stopped.fix: Check free disk space. The game keeps running.

diagnostics_path_invalid.message: Diagnostics are saved as a .zip file.
diagnostics_path_invalid.fix: Pick a file name that ends in .zip.

mod_not_jar.message: Only .jar files can be added as mods.

mod_name_invalid.message: That isn't a mod file name.

mod_managed.message: {{file}} comes with the pack, so the pack decides whether it's on.
mod_managed.fix: Things you add yourself can be turned off or removed.

pack_invalid.message: The pack file {{file}} is damaged or isn't a pack.
pack_invalid.fix: Check the link, or ask the pack's author.

pack_unsupported.message: This pack uses something the launcher can't handle yet: {{what}}.
pack_unsupported.fix: Ask the pack's author, or try another pack.

pack_unsafe_path.message: The pack tried to write outside its folder ({{path}}).
pack_unsafe_path.fix: Don't use this pack, and let its author know.

pack_not_found.fix: Check the link and try again.

pack_link_invalid.message: That doesn't look like a pack link.
pack_link_invalid.fix: Pack links start with https:// and usually end in pack.toml.

no_pack.message: This instance doesn't come from a pack.

not_enough_space.message: Not enough free space: {{needed_mb}} MB needed, {{free_mb}} MB free.
not_enough_space.fix: Free up some space and try again.

instance_locked.message: Another Perland Launcher window is using this instance.
instance_locked.fix: Close the other window, or wait for it to finish.

instance_folder_in_use.message: Another program is using this instance's folder.
instance_folder_in_use.fix: Close any window or program using the folder, then try again.

art_file_invalid.message: That file can't be used as an instance image.
art_file_invalid.fix: Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP image under 5 MB.

banner_focus_invalid.message: That position is outside the picture.

import_not_instance.message: This folder doesn't look like a Minecraft instance.
import_not_instance.fix: Pick the instance's own folder: the one with mods, saves or config inside.

import_inside_launcher.message: That folder belongs to Perland Launcher itself.
import_inside_launcher.fix: Pick a folder from your other launcher.

import_busy.fix: Wait for it to finish, or cancel it.

manual_downloads_needed.message: {{count}} files have to be downloaded by hand.
manual_downloads_needed.fix: Download them from CurseForge, then try again.

update_check_failed.fix: You can still play the version you have.

pack_path_is_folder.message: The pack wants to put a file where you have a folder ({{path}}).
pack_path_is_folder.fix: Move or rename that folder, then try again.

update_download_failed.message: Couldn't download the update. You still have {{version}}.

invite_link_invalid.message: That isn't a Perland invite link.
invite_link_invalid.fix: Invite links look like https://play.example.com/ followed by a long code.

invite_gone.message: This invite link doesn't work anymore. Ask the owner for a new one.

invite_unsupported.message: This server can't be joined from the launcher yet. Join with the address {{address}}.

invite_site_unreachable.message: Couldn't reach the server's Perland site at {{host}}.
invite_site_unreachable.fix: Check the link, or try again later.

invite_rate_limited.message: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.

link_has_pack.message: This instance already gets its mods from a modpack.
link_has_pack.fix: Link a vanilla or imported instance, or join the server as a new instance.

server_pack_unavailable.message: The server's modpack isn't available right now.
server_pack_unavailable.fix: Try again later, or let the server's owner know.

server_pack_pending.message: The server is still preparing the modpack. Try again in a minute.

server_address_unknown.message: Couldn't get the server address, so it isn't in the game's server list.

server_list_failed.message: Couldn't add the server to the game's server list.

server_list_closed.message: The server list isn't open yet. Check back soon.

server_wake_failed.message: Couldn't wake the server. The game will try to join anyway.

sign_in_unavailable.message: That way of signing in isn't available.

sign_in_failed.message: Couldn't sign you in. Try again.

sign_in_timed_out.message: Sign-in took too long. Try again.

too_many_codes.message: Wait {{retryAfter}} seconds before asking for another code.

email_unavailable.message: The email couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.

perland_signed_out.message: You were signed out of Perland.

player_servers_closed.message: Your servers aren't available right now.

too_many_player_servers.message: You have too many servers saved. Unfollow some first.

email_required.message: Free servers need a verified email on your account.

free_server_exists.message: You already have a free server.

too_many_free_servers.message: You can't create another server yet.

free_servers_full.message: Free servers are full right now. Try again later.

invalid_free_server.message: Check the server name: letters, numbers, - and _ only, up to 32.

modpack_unsupported.message: This modpack can't run on a free server.

modpack_too_heavy.message: This modpack needs {{required}} GB; free servers have {{limit}} GB.

free_server_over_disk.message: Your server is out of space, so it stays off.

launcher_update_failed.fix: You can keep playing. It tries again next time you open the launcher.

launcher_update_invalid.message: The launcher update didn't pass its safety check, so it wasn't installed.
launcher_update_invalid.fix: Try again later. If it keeps happening, let us know.

launcher_update_busy.message: Wait for games and installs to finish before restarting to update.
launcher_update_busy.fix: The update also installs when you close the launcher.

internal.fix: Restart the launcher. If it keeps happening, copy the details for support.

browse_rate_limited.message: Too many searches. Try again in {{seconds}} s.

content_incompatible.message: {{name}} doesn't have a version for this instance.
content_incompatible.fix: Try another instance, or a new one.

content_dependency_missing.message: It needs {{name}}, which has no version for this instance.

content_conflict.fix: Remove {{name}} first if you want this one.

content_needs_loader.fix: Pick an instance with Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge.

content_installing.message: Wait for the download to finish.

content_plan_expired.message: That took too long. Try installing again.

browse.title: Browse
browse.offline: You're offline. Browse needs the internet.
browse.rateLimited: Too many searches. Trying again in {{seconds}} s

install.restart: Restart the game to use it.
install.turnOnResourcePack: Turn it on in Options › Resource Packs.
install.turnOnShader: Turn it on in Options › Video Settings › Shader Packs.
